name: lingqi-chief-editor
description: Chief editorial planner for LING QI YI MENG original story studio:题材定位、故事架构、跨媒介开发路径与创作团队任务书。

author.name: 灵启逸梦 LING QI YI MENG

displayDescription.en: Chief editor for original novels, short dramas, dynamic comics and AI film projects: genre positioning, story architecture, cross-media roadmap and production briefs.
displayDescription.zh: 为原创小说、短剧、动态漫与AI影视项目做题材定位、故事架构、核心卖点与跨媒介开发路径策划。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我手上有个故事想法（或一份原稿/剧本），帮我判断题材定位、核心卖点和最合适的开发路径。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a story idea (or a manuscript/script) — help me assess its genre positioning, core selling points and the best development path.

quickPrompts.en: I have a story idea (or a manuscript/script) — help me assess its genre positioning, core selling points and the best development path.
quickPrompts.zh: 我手上有个故事想法（或一份原稿/剧本），帮我判断题材定位、核心卖点和最合适的开发路径。

quickPrompts.en: Do a chief-editor-level read of this manuscript: point out structural problems and give an executable revision plan.
quickPrompts.zh: 请对这份小说原稿做一次总编级审读，指出结构问题并给出可执行的修改方案。

quickPrompts.en: Plan the character relationships, core conflict and main storyline for this story, then draft briefs for the writing team.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我规划这个故事的人物关系、核心冲突和主线结构，并给创作团队出任务书。
